subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should this PR's doctor migration be accepted as the upgrade path for shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` configs?
rationale: The patch intentionally removes a shipped accepted config value and changes how existing configs are repaired, which is compatibility-sensitive even though current runtime already failed to export for `grpc`.

options.title: Accept doctor migration
options.body: Merge the stricter config contract with doctor removing legacy `grpc` and disabling active OTLP export until the operator chooses an OTLP/HTTP collector.

options.title: Keep grpc as a config contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR and sponsor real gRPC exporter support with dependencies, runtime implementation, docs, and tests.

options.title: Revise migration semantics
options.body: Ask for a different doctor repair policy if maintainers want legacy configs preserved or rewritten differently before tightening validation.

recommendation.title: Accept doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the stricter config contract with doctor removing legacy `grpc` and disabling active OTLP export until the operator chooses an OTLP/HTTP collector.

likelyOwner.reason: The original diagnostics exporter/config surface and legacy-migration documentation trace most strongly to this owner signal.
